title: GRIPSession
description: Session configuration established during the GRIP handshake. Defines the provider, region, account scope, and active compliance frameworks for all loop executions within the session.

provider.description: Cloud provider identifier. The reference implementation uses 'aws-ccapi' for AWS Cloud Control API.

region.description: Cloud provider region for API calls.

accountId.description: Cloud provider account identifier. For AWS, this is the 12-digit account ID.

complianceFrameworks.description: Active compliance frameworks for this session. Rules are filtered to only those referenced by these frameworks. Empty array means all available rules are loaded.

securityRulesets.description: Named rule sets loaded for this session.

gripVersion.description: GRIP protocol version this session conforms to.
